answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, burned when the recruit misbehaves. By the spiral of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Work waits on the thread until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the terrace of the next round. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
